description: This file defines API routes for authentication in a FastAPI application, including user registration, login, and profile retrieval. It interacts with authentication services, database sessions, and schemas to handle user-related operations.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )
methods.description: Handles user registration by validating input, calling the AuthService to create a new user, and managing duplicate email errors.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token upon successful login or raises an error for invalid credentials.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )
methods.description: Retrieves the current user profile based on the provided Bearer token.
